objectives: 本課程旨在使學生掌握機構運動學之基本原理與分析技術，為後續如動力學、機械設計等相關課程奠定理論與實務基礎。
content:
Composition of linkages and degrees of freedom
Position and displacement analysis (including graphical and analytical methods)
Velocity analysis (including graphical, analytical, and instantaneous center methods)
Acceleration analysis (including graphical and analytical methods)
Multi-degree-of-freedom planar mechanisms
Cam mechanism design
Gears and gear mechanisms
books: Textbook: 顏鴻森、吳隆庸，現代機構學，東華書局，第一版，2020。 Reference: J .J. Uicker, Jr , G. R. Pennock and J. E. Shigley ； Theory of Machines and Mechanisms, Forth Edition, Oxford University Press , G.H. Martin；Kinematics and Dynamics of Machines, McGraw Hill (高立圖書公司) R.L. Norton；Design of Machinery, McGraw Hill (高立圖書公司)
